Summary: Configure Jira project and Scrum board
Description: Create the Jira project, board, workflow, columns, and initial backlog. No historical sprint activity is claimed.
Create a private Confluence space and the project page tree; link it to Jira and the public evidence repositories.
Begin recording real work sessions, decisions, blockers, risks, evidence, and review outcomes from this point forward.

Summary: Create Jira project and Scrum board
Description: Acceptance: project exists; key is recorded; Scrum board opens; project visibility is reviewed; board URL is documented.

Summary: Configure Jira workflow and board columns
Description: Acceptance: To Do, In Progress, Review, and Done are mapped; Blocked handling is documented; workflow is tested with a sample issue.
Acceptance: CSV preview is checked; epics and tasks are imported; each task is linked to the correct epic; no duplicate or fictitious completed items exist.

Summary: Configure Jira labels and quick filters
Description: Acceptance: agreed labels are applied consistently; filters for blocked, tooling, evidence, and highest priority return expected items.

Summary: Create Confluence space and home page
Description: Acceptance: private space exists; home page describes the case accurately; no invented Jira URL or stakeholder details are included.
Acceptance: all eight top-level pages and three technical workstream child pages exist and are navigable.
Acceptance: Jira project link is available from the Confluence hub and the Confluence hub is linked from the Jira project description or relevant project area.

Summary: Document technical evidence for users migration
Description: Acceptance: repository URL, sample quality counts, MySQL CI evidence, limitations, and evidence review date are recorded.

Summary: Document technical evidence for roles and permissions migration
Description: Acceptance: repository URL, sample quality counts, MySQL CI and foreign-key evidence, limitations, and evidence review date are recorded.

Summary: Document technical evidence for activity history migration
Description: Acceptance: repository URL, sample quality counts, MySQL CI and event validation evidence, limitations, and evidence review date are recorded.

Summary: Run first prospective project status review
Description: Acceptance: a dated status note records actual work completed, current blockers, risks, decisions, next actions, and supporting links.

Summary: Record first decision and change log entries
Description: Acceptance: only decisions actually made after setup are recorded with date, context, options, rationale, and impact.

Summary: Run first retrospective and improvement action
Description: Acceptance: retrospective captures real observations from the first working cycle and assigns one measurable improvement action.
